Commentary.Commentary: That is it! One final game is coming up. Bangladesh Women will hope they take something out of this series. Join us on the 9th of this month at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT) and earlier for the build up. Till then, cheers!

Harmanpreet Kaur wins the Player of the Match award. She says it was a great show by them. Shares they want to give opportunities but they will think later on. Tells they wanted to test themselves in this series as a lot of events are coming up in the future.

Nigar Sultana says they played way too many dots in the powerplay and later on as well. Adds they lack in intent, they need to be brave feels Nigar. Shares this is a young team and hopes a couple of them could make the most of the opportunity coming up.

India Women will be happy as this is yet another superb all round performance from them. The impetus Harmanpreet Kaur and Richa Ghosh showed after the rain pause helped them get some 10-15 runs extra. In reply, the bowlers started well not by taking wickets regularly but by keeping a lid on the run flow. That put a lot of pressure on Bangladesh Women and they gifted away wickets to all the bowlers except Sadhu.  A comfortable win in the end for India.

India Women 4-0 Bangladesh Women! A total one sided affair as Bangladesh Women have been beaten comprehensively. It felt like they were just not ready for the chase. The top order contributed the most before this game and the home team were expected to give a blistering start but no one made an impact. All the batters struggled and it never felt like Bangladesh Women would even sniff for a win here.
Fuller ball, outside off. Akter steps across and swings but misses. India Women win by 56 runs.
